primary_scientific_question: Under a faithful first-party self-evolution workflow, does a semantics-preserving taxonomy reparameterization change an end-of-evolution control/outcome quantity, and can support-quotient control remove that dependence while preserving semantic coverage, verified evolution utility, and the matched proposer/validator call budget? The pre-context single-package baseline class is already analytically reduced.

preferred_primary_substrate.why_this_is_not_second_backbone_rescue: The prior Qwen2.5 execution produced zero qualified units and is formally invalidated, so it is not a scientific backbone result. Qwen3-8B is an author-published tool-call configuration and would be the single preregistered qualified P0 backbone. It must not be adaptively compared with another backbone after outcomes are observed.
preferred_primary_substrate.independent_truth: author parser/question contract plus the 15 released tool-call package validators; environment/downstream utility only when obtained from a frozen first-party executor

causal_timing.upstream_curriculum: Skill-SP sample_skill() selects a skill using skill-level quality/exploration/decay stats before proposer task generation. Generated task context is therefore unavailable at the upstream decision and cannot be given to a same-information baseline.
causal_timing.post_context_retrieval_credit: Task context/outcome may be used by both SQC and a context-conditioned baseline after it exists.

treatments: A preregistered semantics-preserving taxonomy refinement/overlap reparameterization with no new executable support
The same transformed state controlled by the support-quotient semantic target, realized through the shared faithful validator-gated/rejection backend under a matched call budget

strongest_same_information_baselines.upstream_single_package_class: CLOSED BY DECISION-TIME REDUCTION: because the released workflow selects exactly one package before task generation, every same-information randomized pre-context controller induces only a categorical package-weight vector. The released support graph gives a tight max/min exposure lower bound of 2.0 for this entire class.
strongest_same_information_baselines.upstream_realization: SHARED NON-NOVEL BACKEND: matched support-conditioned validator-gated/rejection realization using the identical frozen support target, proposer, validators, semantic coverage requirement, and proposer/validator call budget. The paper does not claim a specialized realization algorithm beyond this backend.
strongest_same_information_baselines.post_context_optional: For retrieval/credit extensions only, a context-conditioned neural/simplex router with identical task context, support fingerprints, quality/outcome evidence, exact-clone quotient preprocessing, capacity, and fixed budget. This is not the primary upstream P0 baseline.

primary_outcomes: distance between original and transformed end-of-step/end-of-evolution semantic control distributions
cumulative independently verified evolution utility/regret where a faithful executor is available
downstream task/environment success where available under the same frozen run

go_stop.mechanism_and_method_survive: Native controller is representation-sensitive under a qualified faithful run; quotient control materially reduces the preregistered transformation distance while preserving semantic coverage, verified evolution utility, and matched proposer/validator call budget.
go_stop.method_operationally_insufficient: Quotient control reaches invariance only by exceeding the matched call budget, losing semantic coverage, or reducing verified evolution utility beyond tolerance; retain STRI problem/theory but stop or redesign the current method.
go_stop.dynamic_problem_weakens: A qualified faithful native controller shows no meaningful representation effect under the preregistered transformation; stop C4 and do not scale the paper as a dynamic-harm claim.
go_stop.invalid: Any provenance, parser/contract qualification, runtime, or support failure prevents scientific update.

next_action: Launch the exact frozen Qwen3-8B P0-A once on host 231 when the unrelated GPU workload releases the resource gate. Do not redesign, retune, move to another backbone, or generate a second bank before this run resolves.
